description: Daily model spend per owner directory, written by the spend collector. by_owner and reqs_by_owner are arrays of per-project records (owner, usd / owner, requests), normalised so the schema is bounded no matter how many projects spend money (crew#71).

by_model.description: usd per model served that day (claude-guards crew#371)

reqs_by_model.description: requests per model served that day (claude-guards crew#371)

tokens.description: token counts by driver: raw_input, cache_read (context re-sent unchanged), cache_write, output (claude-guards crew#372)

reread_pct.description: cache_read as a percent of tokens sent (raw_input+cache_read+cache_write); null when nothing was sent
